name: Seven Foot Knoll Lighthouse

note: The Wikipedia article contains both current and original offshore coordinates. This asset is at the mapped Pier5 circle, centered−76.6053511,39.2835825; it is not the former Patapsco offshore site. The CoastGuard40ft value is height above mean high water when on station, not a surveyed current ground height. Current12.4m is an estimate consistent with OSM12m and the relocated exterior photos. The historical1900photo1 is not a current geometry/paint reference; current2and5 show the red dwelling, black framing and land-based supports, while3confirms green shutters and white frames. The measured51ftplatform and40ftdwelling diameters are retained. An estimated switchback access stair is aligned east from the mapped circular frame, enclosed by a separately authored component mask; it is not claimed as a surveyed OSM stair. Both LODs keep the raised underside open, nine load-bearing piles, actual diagonal braces, hollow balcony rails and glazed upper light chamber. The historic pier plinth, pavement and surrounding water are not authored. Feet are at rigidlocaly0; later appgrounddatum verification is required. No lettering, plaques or lens texture.
